name: Ben Gunness
source:
"Well, I guess I'd rather be with you."

Ben is friendly and caring, always putting others first. While he doesn't expect much in return, he does hope that his friendships will give him the strength to support himself. Has a habit of concealing his true feelings. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarslip/serial-lover/]Kickstarter[/url]]
